name: tooltrust-mcp
description: Scans MCP servers for prompt injection, supply chain attacks, excessive permissions, and code execution risks. Includes an offline blacklist that catches known-compromised packages like LiteLLM 1.82.7/1.82.8 and Trivy with zero latency.
